items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: Tasha saw it, though, and played it in the movie

ctx.x: From the movie, the Leslie Howard, uh, movie, yeah. Dun, Oh, yeah.
Yeah, Tasha saw it, though, and played it in the movie, and then he did it.

Yeah. And he, the first chorus, where you play the melody, and the second chorus was variations in double time against the melody. And then, uh, oh, another tune we worked on was that, uh, Prisoner of Love, which was popular at the time, you know. And his idea was, you have to take the, take the, uh, melodies that the people want to hear, the popular, the popular tunes, and, uh, play the melody, and then play variations on it, but, you have to have the relationship between the variation and the melody clear, you…
